angle point, turns back to south-east; south-west side cut by plate edge, centre approximate

ends at Railroad Avenue and the railroad

notes: Strip is mostly factories, rail sidings and the Mill Creek. The 40 ft avenue running north-west from Spring Grove Avenue at (4828,1795) has only 'AVE.' printed inside the strip; the name CHICKERING is printed on its continuation north-west of the railroad (about x 3800-3950, y 250-450), so it is recorded as Chickering Avenue. Spring Grove Avenue's name is not printed inside the strip (identified by its 100 ft width and house numbers 4878-5106). Kessler: only 'KESSLER' read, suffix assumed Avenue. Mitchell Avenue crosses the Mill Creek near (4550,5130) (bridge, not a crossing); the street 'AVENUE' label is printed east of the strip. Hope Street name printed at about (3960,3230); its width figure at the Durham end is unclear (40, 50 or 60), drawn about 50 ft. Durham Avenue is printed 40 but drawn about 46 ft wide.
